desc: The KS7 GEN2 is a lightweight, 12-gauge bullpup pump-action shotgun with a 6+1 capacity of 3" shells or 7+1 with 2-3/4". Measuring just over 26" in overall length and weighing 6.8 lbs unloaded, it delivers full-length performance in a compact package. The GEN2 incorporates a five-slot Picatinny-style rail molded into the forend, enabling direct attachment of vertical grips and other accessories. A rail cap is included to maintain a smooth, traditional profile when the rail is not in use.
